title: Design System: Security+ SY0-701 PBQ Simulator

body.purpose: Scenario, requirements and explanations; scales with the text-size control.

section-tab.purpose: Uppercase module headings inside the red tab.

data.purpose: Timer, ports, IPs, commands and counters only.

shadows.name: float
shadows.purpose: Only for surfaces that float over scrolling content: the sticky action bar and modal dialogs.

motion.name: state
motion.purpose: Color transitions on hover and selection.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one primary action per view, such as Submit and Validate.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #c8102e; color: #ffffff; padding: 10px 20px; border: none; border-radius: 12px; font: 700 12px 'Source Sans 3', system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #a90d27; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #c8102e; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Next PBQ: strong but not red.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: #2f353e; color: #ffffff; padding: 8px 16px; border: none; border-radius: 12px; font: 600 12px 'Source Sans 3', system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #454c56; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #c8102e; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Neutral Button
components.description: Previous, Reset and other low-emphasis actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-neutral { background: #e1e4e8; color: #2f353e; padding: 8px 16px; border: none; border-radius: 12px; font: 600 12px 'Source Sans 3', system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-neutral:hover { background: #c8cdd3; color: #101317; } .ds-btn-neutral:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #c8102e; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Section Tab
components.description: The red tab that heads every module.
components.css: .ds-section-tab { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; margin: 0; padding: 4px 10px; border-radius: 4px 4px 0 0; background: #c8102e; color: #ffffff; font: 700 11px 'Source Sans 3', system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-transform: uppercase; }

components.name: Module
components.description: A flat white pane defined by a hairline.
components.html:
Requerimientos

Coloca cada control en la posición del diagrama que satisface cada necesidad.
components.css: .ds-module { background: #ffffff; border: 1px solid #e1e4e8; border-radius: 16px; padding: 20px; } .ds-module-tab { display: inline-flex; margin: 0 0 12px; padding: 4px 10px; border-radius: 4px 4px 0 0; background: #c8102e; color: #fff; font: 700 11px 'Source Sans 3', system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-module-body { margin: 0; color: #2f353e; font: 400 15px/1.6 'Source Sans 3', system-ui, sans-serif; }

components.name: PBQ Chip
components.description: Navigation chip in the PBQ strip; the active one is outlined in red.
components.css: .ds-chips { display: flex; gap: 6px; } .ds-chip { background: #ffffff; color: #454c56; border: 1px solid #e1e4e8; border-radius: 12px; padding: 6px 12px; font: 700 12px 'Source Sans 3', system-ui, sans-serif; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; cursor: pointer; } .ds-chip:hover { color: #101317; border-color: #c8cdd3; } .ds-chip-active { border-color: #a90d27; color: #101317; background: #fdf1f3; } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #c8102e; outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview: The simulator should feel like the screen a candidate meets on exam day, not a hacker console. Work happens on white panes over a cool-gray page, set in a plain institutional sans, with one brand red that marks only what matters: the primary action, where you are, and the label at the head of each module. Everything else is neutral ink, so the scenario text and the task carry the page.
keyCharacteristics: Light exam screen by default, charcoal on demand, one red in both.
Flat modules defined by a 1px hairline, not by shadow.
A small red tab heads every module.
Monospace only for data: timers, counts, IPs, ports, commands.

rules.name: The Red Means Here Rule
rules.body: Red appears only on the primary action, the current position, section tabs, focus and genuine errors. Icons, counts, numbers and decoration are neutral ink.

rules.name: The One Token Layer Rule
rules.body: Components keep the original utility names; src/index.css redefines what each shade means per theme. Shades 950–800 are tints, 700–500 are fills and borders, 400–100 are text.

rules.name: The Mono Is Data Rule
rules.body: Monospace is for values, never for navigation, labels or a technical look.

rules.name: The No Eyebrow Rule
rules.body: Position and category information sits as sentence-case metadata; no red, tracked, uppercase line above a heading.

rules.name: The One Elevation Rule
rules.body: A surface gets a hairline or a shadow, never both, unless it floats over scrolling content.

dos: Do use the shade roles of the token layer instead of new colors.
Do head every new module with the section-tab utility.
Do use text-on-accent for text on any filled brand or state color.
Do wrap always-dark surfaces (terminals, consoles) in .theme-dark.
Do keep correct and incorrect distinguishable by icon or text, not color alone.
donts: Don't use red for icons, counts or decoration.
Don't combine a hairline border with a wide shadow on in-page modules.
Don't introduce a second accent hue; information color is navy only.
Don't use CompTIA logos or wording that implies affiliation.
